items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: Old Man Riley was the owner of the proprietor.

ctx.x: It looks like a fest isn't going to come today. I wanted to ask did you ever play with Professor Mineta?

Oh no more than around his house or out somewhere at some friends house. Never any jobs. We had no fun just like right now. We take one two little drinks somebody get to singing. I'd grab the horn oh he'd grab it he'd play and I'd play and we'd play together like that or something like that. That's the only way. But another thing he played with the girl I'm telling you about Helen Edwards at the Saint Sue Hall. That's where fest was playing with her. Up on Howard. Yeah on Howard Street for Old Man Riley at Saint…

Yeah. Can you tell me who was your favorite clarinet player of all that you heard any place or any time? Who would, if you had to listen to just one clarinet player once more who would you want to hear?
